syllabus_topics: Components of aircraft and their influence on configuration (fuselage, wings and empennage)
Influence of geometry caused by special mission requirements (e.g., stealth capabilities)
Derivation of wing geometry from wing loading and mission requirements
Calculation and elaboration of data sets in aerodynamics, propulsion and masses
Estimation and calculation methods for aerodynamic forces (lift and drag from advanced wing theory)
Estimation and calculation methods for moments (neutral point) in sub-, trans- and supersonic velocity ranges
Determination of an appropriate aerofoil profile
Creation of aerofoil, wing and aircraft polars
Off-design layout by means of high-lift devices
institution: Fh Joanneum University Of Applied Sciences — Luftfahrt / Aviation (B.Sc.)
